final: WITH album_averages AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_list_price, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds) AS average_size_to_length FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_size_to_length) AS overall_average FROM album_averages) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.average_list_price, a.average_size_to_length, a.average_size_to_length - o.overall_average AS difference FROM album_averages AS a JOIN overall AS o ON o.overall_average IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
